stem: Voltmarkt's business sales team splits its Business Care deals into medium and large offices. The large-office win rate fell from 40% in Q2 to 25% in Q3: in Q2 the team closed 5 large-office deals and won 2, in Q3 it closed 8 and won 2. The sales director asks: "Are large offices closing worse?" Which answer is best?

options.text: Yes: the win rate fell by 15 percentage points in a single quarter
Too early to say: with 2 wins in each quarter, it may be chance
No: the fall must come from open deals counted as losses
No: win rates cannot be compared between two quarters
